alieninfiltrator.name: Alien Infiltrator
alieninfiltrator.desc: Once per turn, this card can move to an adjacent (horizontal) unoccupied Monster Card Zone. If no Spell, Trap or Monster Card on your opponent's side of the field is in the same column as this card, it can attack your opponent directly.

battlewaltz.name: Battle Waltz
battlewaltz.desc: Target 1 Synchro Monster you control; Special Summon 1 "Waltz Token" with the current Type, Attribute, Level, ATK and DEF of that monster. Neither player takes any battle damage from attacks involving this Token.

bingocard.name: Bingo Card

bixiwateroftheyangzing.name: Bixi, Water of the Yang Zing
bixiwateroftheyangzing.desc: When this card you control is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Yang Zing" monster from your Deck in Attack Position, except "Bixi, Water of the Yang Zing". You can only use this effect of "Bixi, Water of the Yang Zing" once per turn. Once per turn, during your opponent's Main Phase or Battle Phase, you can: Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster, using only "Yang Zing" monsters you control (this is a Quick Effect). A Synchro Monster that used this card as a Synchro Material is unaffected by Trap effects.

blackmetaldragon.name: Black Metal Dragon
blackmetaldragon.desc: You can target 1 "Red-Eyes" monster you control; equip this monster from your hand or field to that target. It gains 600 ATK. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Red-Eyes" card from your Deck to your hand.

brainwashingbeam.name: Brainwashing Beam
brainwashingbeam.desc: Select 1 monster with at least 1 A-Counter on your opponent's side of the field and take control of that monster. During each of your End Phases, remove 1 A-Counter from that controlled monster. If all A-Counters are removed from that monster, or that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

changeofheart.name: Change of Heart
changeofheart.desc: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; take control of it until the End Phase.

convertcontact.name: Convert Contact
convertcontact.desc: If you control no monsters: Send 2 "Neo-Spacian" monsters (1 from your hand and 1 from your Deck) to the GY, then draw 2 cards.

crystalraigeki.name: Crystal Raigeki
crystalraigeki.desc: Send 1 "Crystal Beast" card from your Spell & Trap Card Zone to the Graveyard to target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

crystronhalqifibrax.name: Crystron Halqifibrax
crystronhalqifibrax.desc:
2 monsters, including a Tuner
If this card is Link Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower Tuner from your hand or Deck in Defense Position, but it cannot activate its effects this turn. During your opponent's Main Phase or Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can banish this card you control; Special Summon 1 Tuner Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck. (This is treated as a Synchro Summon.) You can only use each effect of "Crystron Halqifibrax" once per turn.

ektoenneacrafttromaria.name: Ekto Enneacraft - "tromarIA"
ektoenneacrafttromaria.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
Each time a monster(s) is flipped face-up, place 1 E.C. Counter on this card. You can pay 900 LP; reveal 3 "Enneacraft" cards from your Deck, your opponent randomly picks 1 for you to add to your hand, shuffle the rest into the Deck. You can only use this effect of "Ekto Enneacraft - "tromarIA"" once per turn.

[ Monster Effect ] 
FLIP: Negate the effects of 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls, until the end of this turn.
When your opponent activates a card or effect that includes an effect that Special Summons a monster(s) (Quick Effect): You can change this face-down card to face-up Defense Position; add 1 "Enneacraft" card from your Deck to your hand. You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand in face-down Defense Position. You cannot Special Summon the turn you activate this effect, except in face-down Defense Position.

emergencyassistance.name: Emergency Assistance
emergencyassistance.desc: Activate during your Main Phase 2, to Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster from your Graveyard that was destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard this turn.

fabledraven.name: Fabled Raven
fabledraven.desc: Once per turn: You can discard any number of cards, and if you do, this card gains 1 Level and 400 ATK for each discarded card, until the end of this turn.

fiberjar.name: Fiber Jar
fiberjar.desc: FLIP: Each player shuffles all cards from their hand, field, and Graveyard into the Deck, then draws 5 cards.

formulasynchron.name: Formula Synchron
formulasynchron.desc:
1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner monster
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can draw 1 card. Once per Chain, during your opponent's Main Phase, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon using this card you control.

gallugalludtheendlessenigma.name: Gallugallud the Endless Enigma
gallugalludtheendlessenigma.desc: ''A bird monster clad in flickering flames, it can shapeshift into all sorts of things. After switching back and forth between human and bird, it has forgotten its original self.''

gimmickpuppetterrorbaby.name: Gimmick Puppet Terror Baby
gimmickpuppetterrorbaby.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 "Gimmick Puppet" monster in your GY, except "Gimmick Puppet Terror Baby"; Special Summon it in Defense Position. You can banish this card from your GY; your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to the activation of your "Gimmick Puppet" monster effects this turn.

gladiatorbeastbestiari.name: Gladiator Beast Bestiari
gladiatorbeastbestiari.desc: If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a "Gladiator Beast" monster: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card attacked or was attacked: You can shuffle it into the Deck; Special Summon 1 "Gladiator Beast" monster from your Deck, except "Gladiator Beast Bestiari".

glowingcrossbow.name: Glowing Crossbow
glowingcrossbow.desc:
Equip only to a "Blackwing" monster. It gains 500 ATK/DEF. You can only use each of the following effects of "Glowing Crossbow" once per turn.
● If the equipped monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.
● If this card is sent to the GY because the equipped monster was used as a Synchro Material: You can add this card from the GY to your hand.

greedquasar.name: Greed Quasar
greedquasar.desc: This card's original ATK and DEF are each equal to its Level x 300. This monster's Level is increased by the Level of monsters it destroys by battle.

lemonmagiciangirl.name: Lemon Magician Girl
lemonmagiciangirl.desc: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 "Magician Girl" monster, except "Lemon Magician Girl"; add 1 Spellcaster-Type monster from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, if this card is targeted for an attack: You can Special Summon 1 Spellcaster-Type monster from your hand, but its effects (if any) are negated, then change the attack target to it, and if you do, the attacking monster's ATK becomes half its current ATK.

lordgaiathefierceknight.name: Lord Gaia the Fierce Knight
lordgaiathefierceknight.desc: If your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Once per turn, if a monster(s) with ATK higher than this card is Special Summoned to your opponent's field (except during the Damage Step): You can make this card gain 700 ATK until the end of this turn.

magicalhound.name: Magical Hound
magicalhound.desc: If this card is in your hand or GY: You can target 1 face-up Spell/Trap your opponent controls; return it to the hand, and if you do, Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Magical Hound" once per Duel.

magicplanter.name: Magic Planter
magicplanter.desc: Send 1 face-up Continuous Trap you control to the GY; draw 2 cards.

morphtronicmagnen.name: Morphtronic Magnen
morphtronicmagnen.desc: ● While in Attack Position: If your opponent controls a face-up monster, this card can only select their highest ATK monster as an attack target. ● While in Defense Position: Your opponent cannot select another monster as an attack target.

number21frozenladyjustice.name: Number 21: Frozen Lady Justice
number21frozenladyjustice.desc:
2 Level 6 monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by detaching 1 Xyz Material from a Rank 5 Xyz Monster you control, then using that Xyz Monster as the Xyz Material. (Xyz Materials attached to that monster also become Xyz Materials on this card.) This card gains 1000 ATK for each Xyz Material attached to it. Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; destroy all Defense Position monsters your opponent controls.

ooguchi.name: Ooguchi
ooguchi.desc: This monster may attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

spiritualbeastpettlephin.name: Spiritual Beast Pettlephin
spiritualbeastpettlephin.desc: Once per turn: You can banish 1 "Ritual Beast" card from your hand, then target 1 card your opponent controls; return it to the hand. You can only Special Summon "Spiritual Beast Pettlephin(s)" once per turn.

stealthangecradle.name: Stealth Angecradle
stealthangecradle.desc: ''A mysterious entity known as "the angel that brings salvation to heretical souls". The only thing left behind after "that thing" passes through is eternal silence... Ange Passe.''

theforgivingmaiden.name: The Forgiving Maiden
theforgivingmaiden.desc: Tribute this face-up card to return to your hand 1 of your monsters destroyed as a result of battle during this turn.

trojangladiatorbeast.name: Trojan Gladiator Beast
trojangladiatorbeast.desc: Special Summon 1 "Gladiator Beast" monster from your hand to your opponent's side of the field. Then, draw 1 card.

tsuchigumothepoisonousmayakashi.name: Tsuchigumo, the Poisonous Mayakashi
tsuchigumothepoisonousmayakashi.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters / You can only control 1 "Tsuchigumo, the Poisonous Mayakashi". You can only use each of these effects of "Tsuchigumo, the Poisonous Mayakashi" once per turn.
● If a Synchro Monster in your possession whose original Level is 7 is destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect while this card is in the GY: You can banish 1 other Zombie monster from your GY, and if you do, Special Summon this card.
● If this card is Special Summoned from the GY: You can have each player send the top 3 cards from their Deck to the GY.

unibird.name: Unibird
unibird.desc: You can remove from play this face-up card, and 1 face-up monster you control, to select 1 Synchro Monster in your Graveyard with a Level less than or equal to the combined original Levels of the other 2 monsters. Special Summon that Synchro Monster.

vodnikathefountainspirit.name: Vodnika the Fountain Spirit
vodnikathefountainspirit.desc: If a Level 10 monster(s) is sent to the GY, except "Vodnika the Fountain Spirit" (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your GY (if it was there when the monster was sent) or hand (even if not) in Defense Position, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can target 1 Level 10 monster in your GY; Special Summon it to your opponent's field (but negate its effects), then draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Vodnika the Fountain Spirit" once per turn.

widespreadruin.name: Widespread Ruin
widespreadruin.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy the Attack Position monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied).
